summary: Wakulla County lookout site in the Apalachicola National Forest. Map records show a tower point, but no source found describes it today.

facts.status_note: Not confirmed standing: the only map record asks whether the tower is still present.

notes_for_editor: Name, county and agency come from the Forest Lookouts listing; the 62 ft elevation and USGS quadrangle from TopoQuest (record 18 m matches); OSM coordinates match the record. No build date, design, staffing or access found in two searches and five page reads. The only sign of a tower today is the OSM note 'still present?'. The undated USFS handbook says four towers were built on the Wakulla district but names none, so this site is not tied to them. A TopoQuest nearby-features list (seen in search results, not fetched) shows a separate Pope Still Lookout Tower entry at the same coordinates; not cited. The record's status 'unknown' is kept.
